description: Events and background tasks for a Next.js app, on BullMQ with Redis or Valkey: define tasks and events, dispatch or emit them by name from server code, and run them in a worker started from instrumentation.ts.
rules: If a snippet in this manual disagrees with the installed .d.ts, trust the .d.ts.
Import everything from the package root, @flefebvre/nextasking.
Call the instance from server code only: route handlers, server actions, instrumentation.ts.
